1: // Minimal Asteroid Miner game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio context for sound effects
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   const playSound = (type) => {
7:     const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:     const g = audioCtx.createGain();
9:     o.connect(g);
10:     g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
11:     let freq = 440;
12:     let dur = 0.1;
13:     switch (type) {
14:       case 'laser':
15:         freq = 800; dur = 0.07; break;
16:       case 'hit':
17:         freq = 200; dur = 0.2; break;
18:       case 'gameover':
19:         freq = 100; dur = 0.5; break;
20:     }
21:     o.frequency.value = freq;
22:     o.start();
23:     o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
24:   };
25: 
26:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
27:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
28:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
29:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
30:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
31: 
32:   // Enhanced graphics setup
33:   const stars = [];
34:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
35:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
36:   }
37:   const lasers = [];
38:   const addLaser = (x, y) => {
39:     lasers.push({ x, y, life: 0.3 }); // seconds
40:   };
41: 
42:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
43:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
44:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
45:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
46: 
47:   // Game state
48:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, vx: 0, vy: 0, size: 15, angle: 0, hp: 100 };
49:   const asteroids = [];
50:   const drones = [];
51:   let resources = 0;
52:   const keys = {};
53: 
54:   // Helpers
55:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
56:   const addAsteroid = () => {
57:     const r = rand(20, 50);
58:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: rand(0, height), r, rot: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), speed: rand(0.5, 2) });
59:   };
60:   const addDrone = () => {
61:     const size = 20;
62:     drones.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: rand(0, height), size, dir: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), speed: 1.5 });
63:   };
64: 
65:   // Populate initial objects
66:   for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) addAsteroid();
67:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) addDrone();
68: 
69:   // Input handling
70:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
71:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
72:   canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
73:     // Ensure audio context is running (required by some browsers)
74:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
75:     // Play laser sound
76:     playSound('laser');
77:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
78:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
79:     const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
80:     // Laser visual
81:     addLaser(mx, my);
82:     // Simple laser: remove first asteroid under cursor
83:     for (let i = 0; i < asteroids.length; i++) {
84:       const a = asteroids[i];
85:       const dx = mx - a.x,
86:         dy = my - a.y;
87:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < a.r * a.r) {
88:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
89:         resources++;
90:         addAsteroid();
91:         break;
92:       }
93:     }
94:   });
95: 
96:   // Game loop
97:   function update(dt) {
98:     const speed = 150; // pixels per second
99:     // Update velocity based on input
100:     ship.vx = 0; ship.vy = 0;
101:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.vy -= speed;
102:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.vy += speed;
103:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.vx -= speed;
104:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.vx += speed;
105:     // Apply velocity
106:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
107:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
108:     // Update ship angle to point direction of movement (if any)
109:     if (ship.vx !== 0 || ship.vy !== 0) ship.angle = Math.atan2(ship.vy, ship.vx);
110:     // Keep ship inside bounds (wrap)
111:     ship.x = (ship.x + width) % width;
112:     ship.y = (ship.y + height) % height;
113: 
114:     // Move asteroids (slow drift)
115:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
116:       a.x += Math.cos(a.rot) * a.speed;
117:       a.y += Math.sin(a.rot) * a.speed;
118:       // wrap
119:       if (a.x < -a.r) a.x = width + a.r;
120:       if (a.x > width + a.r) a.x = -a.r;
121:       if (a.y < -a.r) a.y = height + a.r;
122:       if (a.y > height + a.r) a.y = -a.r;
123:       // collision with ship
124:       const dx = ship.x - a.x,
125:         dy = ship.y - a.y;
126:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (ship.size + a.r) ** 2) {
127:         ship.hp = Math.max(0, ship.hp - 10);
128:         playSound('hit');
129:       }
130:     });
131: 
132:     // Move drones (simple back‑and‑forth)
133:     drones.forEach(d => {
134:       d.x += Math.cos(d.dir) * d.speed;
135:       d.y += Math.sin(d.dir) * d.speed;
136:       if (d.x < 0 || d.x > width || d.y < 0 || d.y > height) d.dir += Math.PI; // bounce
137:       // collision with ship
138:       const dx = ship.x - d.x,
139:         dy = ship.y - d.y;
140:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (ship.size + d.size) ** 2) {
141:         ship.hp = Math.max(0, ship.hp - 20);
142:         playSound('hit');
143:       }
144:     });
145: 
146:     // Update lasers (fade out)
147:     lasers.forEach(l => l.life -= dt);
148:     // Remove expired lasers
149:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
150:       if (lasers[i].life <= 0) lasers.splice(i, 1);
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   function draw() {
155:     // Starfield background
156:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
157:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
158:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
159:     stars.forEach(s => {
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     });
164:     // Lasers
165:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'cyan';
166:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
167:     lasers.forEach(l => {
168:       ctx.beginPath();
169:       ctx.moveTo(l.x, l.y);
170:       ctx.lineTo(l.x, l.y - 15);
171:       ctx.stroke();
172:     });
173: 
174:     // Ship
175:     ctx.save();
176:     ctx.save();
177:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
178:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
179:     ctx.beginPath();
180:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size);
181:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size / 2, ship.size);
182:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size / 2, ship.size);
183:     ctx.closePath();
184:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
185:     ctx.fill();
186:     ctx.restore();
187: 
188:     // Asteroids with simple shading
189:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
190:       ctx.save();
191:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
192:       ctx.rotate(a.rot);
193:       // radial gradient for depth
194:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.r * 0.3, 0, 0, a.r);
195:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
196:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#333');
197:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
200:       ctx.fill();
201:       ctx.restore();
202:     });
203: 
204:     // Drones
205:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
206:     drones.forEach(d => {
207:       ctx.fillRect(d.x - d.size / 2, d.y - d.size / 2, d.size, d.size);
208:     });
209: 
210:     // UI overlay
211:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
212:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
213:     ctx.fillText('Resources: ' + resources, 10, 20);
214:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
215:     ctx.fillRect(10, 30, ship.hp * 2, 10);
216:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
217:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 30, 200, 10);
218:   }
219: 
220:   let last = performance.now();
221:   function loop(now) {
222:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
223:     last = now;
224:     if (ship.hp > 0) {
225:       update(dt);
226:       draw();
227:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
228: } else {
229:         // Ensure audio context is running
230:         if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
231:         playSound('gameover');
232:         ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
233:         ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
234:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
235:       }
236:   }
237:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
238: })();
